name: Clinical Congress 2026
description: Clinical Congress is the annual educational meeting of the American College of Surgeons, offering courses, scientific sessions, and abstract presentations across surgical specialties. The 2026 edition takes place at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center and includes in person attendance with virtual participation options.

name: Clinical Congress 2027
description: Clinical Congress is the annual educational meeting of the American College of Surgeons, offering courses, scientific sessions, and abstract presentations across surgical specialties. The 2027 edition is scheduled to take place in San Diego, California.

notes: Only the meeting dates and host city are published so far on the official future-congress page; no specific venue or abstract/registration deadlines have been announced as of 2026-09-10. Coordinates given are for San Diego city center rather than a specific venue. Deadlines are left empty rather than estimated because ACS has not yet opened a call for the 2027 congress; the 2026 edition's general abstract deadline fell in early March, roughly seven months before the meeting, which may be a rough guide once ACS publishes the actual 2027 call.
